page.layout: One column of running text, with two centred author headings and their italic quotations. Below the last paragraph, a centred word "Idem". No marginal notes on this page. Fragments at the right edge belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.

main_text.p: nomine, vel typis, vel scripto circumfertur, ab integritatis suæ gradu deturbata aliorum imperitia, vel negligentia, & forte maleuolentia fiunt, ut notauit Allatius in difertissima Ioanna Papissæ fabula.
main_text.head: MELCHIOR INCOFER S. I. In Annalibus Ecclesiasticis Regni Vngariæ Anno 879. p. 96.

p.i: Atque hinc erupit fabula de Ioanna Papissa, quam Marianus Scotus, Platina, aliíque ex istis impudenter veri infulso figmento obtruse-runt. Sed plurimi doctissimi viri egregie confutarunt, quos inter recentissimus palmam extulit Leo Allatius multis eruditis lucubrationibus clarus, & plane ludos fecit, qui hinc Ecclesiæ Romanæ puerliter officere se existimant.

main_text.head: BARTOLDUS NIHUSIUS In Hypodigmate in Præfatione. p. 11.

p.i: Sed hanc istorum hominum vitilitigationem pluribus excutimus, tum alibi, tum in editis ad Allatium de Papissa, nostrumque Prosphonematicum, tum in Hypodigmate.

page.notes: The right-edge fragments (f, n, E, xi, Q, Ar, Po, ste) are from the neighbouring page and were left out. Printed "aliíque" has an accent that may be a printer's mark. Printed "p. 1 1." read as p. 11. The line-end mark after "aliorum" is a rule or dash, not a hyphen, so the word is written whole. "obtruse-runt" keeps the printed line-end hyphen. Long s has been normalised to s throughout (e.g. suæ, Papissæ, istorum).
